notes.title: Animocity
notes.content:
[h3]The Animocity demo is now live.[/h3]


[i]Animocity is a game where we follow a bunch of magical animals down a maze of dungeons in which they fight for their survival.[/i]


If you are a fan of Roguelikes, dungeon-crawlers, and magical top-down action, be sure to give the demo a try.

The game is still in development so the demo might feel lacking in some places. If you have some ideas, questions, or would just like to chat, feel free to reach out on [url=https://discord.gg/BJPTtn]Discord[/url]


ːsteamhappyː


Sincerely
G Bear Productions
